national.name: Bank code, branch code and account number

note: Bank of Taiwan, the largest bank, in the file formats of its corporate transfer service (read 2026-10-30, undated): the payee's bank code is three digits and the branch code four; the payee's account number is a field of sixteen digits, left-aligned and not padded, and its EDI format takes the account's first fourteen digits. Account lengths vary by bank (the Central Bank's table of offshore-unit accounts shows 11 to 14 digits by bank) and no national standard fixing them was read, so the fourteen of Bank of Taiwan's EDI format is written; a shorter account is read with leading zeros. No national check digit is published; none is modelled.
